note: Playwright e2e against production during the v5.2 rollout (26 Nov 2026). The first chromium-390 pass of a, b and a failed c (and a restarted a) ran at 02:19-02:24 UTC. Those runs left fresh keys and Pockets that were not copied into own-accounts.json, because the later successful rerun (02:30-02:52 UTC) overwrote frontend/evidence/v4/e2e/chromium-390-*.json. The later files also omitted the recipient keys of drops s7 and s8 (only the recipient Pockets were listed). This file reconstructs every account from the spend ledger and from the live v5.2 prod contracts, so /api/stats does not count them as external.
